item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0030-E001","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0030-E002","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The military-intelligence report was directed to Defense Secretary Luis Cresencio Sandoval, whose direct hierarchical relationship to the relevant Estado Mayor structure is described, and he received information from the operation. The CMI was described as not publicly integrated into Sedena’s regulatory structure and as using private-communications interventions; the excerpt reports no located request for judicial authorization. The CNDH concluded excessive use of force in the underlying Nuevo Laredo case, and no military personnel had been sanctioned by the report date.","notes":["Narrowed “direct hierarchical responsibility” to the excerpt’s statement that the Estado Mayor depended directly on Sandoval.","Narrowed “without an identified judicial authorization” to the reported absence of a located request for judicial intervention."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0030-E003","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0030-E004","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0030-E005","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0030-E006","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0030-E007","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0030-E008","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"A thesis analyzing López Obrador’s 2018 Twitter activity recorded 245 tweets in the overall analyzed dataset, including 206 during the campaign; the largest campaign categories were political encouragement and visits/acts. Campaign commitments/programs comprised 10.7%, accusations 10.4%, and cabinet information 2.1%. Activity increased from 0.59 messages per day in the pre-campaign to 2.3 during the campaign, with no tweets recorded on election day and five posted the following day.","notes":["Corrected the unsupported “245 campaign tweets” to 245 overall and 206 campaign tweets.","Corrected the campaign percentages for accusations and cabinet information to the values shown in the campaign table."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0030-E009","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0030-E010","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0030-E011","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0030-E012","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"In October 2023 Amnesty International reported that Mexican authorities’ handling of the Ayotzinapa investigation created major obstacles and could affect access to truth, justice, and reparation: SEDENA refused to provide key intercepted-communications records to the independent expert group, the group departed after a lack of cooperation, the former head of the special investigation unit resigned after alleging interference, and López Obrador supported the army while criticizing victim organizations and publicly stating that an investigation was underway against the former prosecutor. Amnesty also reported Pegasus surveillance of the victim-representing organization Centro Prodh in April 2023.","notes":["Narrowed “impeded truth, justice, and reparation” to the excerpt’s wording that the conduct could affect access and represented obstacles.","Narrowed “former special prosecutor” to the excerpt’s “former head of the Special Investigation and Litigation Unit.”"]}]}
